plan.title: RFQ required T&C blocks vendor submission

steps.note: Open the eRFX project creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for this case.
Allow the buyer to add vendors during event creation.
Provide the mandatory event title.
Create the required Technical and RFQ stages.
configure the rfp stage on its own tab
rfp needs its own template
Add one item for the vendor quote.
configure the rfq stage on its own tab
rfq needs its own template
Commit the 30-minute event schedule.
Add one QA vendor for the buyer and vendor flow.
Publish the configured two-stage event.
Confirm the event reached its published project page.
Open the invited vendor's supplier-portal session.
Open the technical stage first to verify RFQ clauses are stage-specific.
The required RFQ clause must not appear on the technical stage.
The optional RFQ clause must not appear on the technical stage.
Open the RFQ pricing stage where the clauses apply.
Verify the required RFQ clause is shown to the vendor.
Verify the optional RFQ clause is shown to the vendor.
Accept only the optional clause.
Submission must be blocked because the required clause remains unchecked.
Accept the required clause after the blocked attempt.
Submit the quote after all required terms are accepted.
Confirm the vendor's RFQ submission succeeded.
